item.title: Your brain on ChatGPT: Accumulation of cognitive debt when using an AI assistant
item.description:
📝 Participants were divided into three groups: LLM, Search Engine, and Brain-only (no tools). In a fourth session, LLM users were reassigned to Brain-only group (LLM-to-Brain), and Brain-only users were reassigned to LLM condition (Brain-to-LLM). EEG revealed significant differences in brain connectivity: Brain-only participants exhibited the strongest, most distributed networks; Search Engine users showed moderate engagement; and LLM users displayed the weakest connectivity.
🔗 Read more: https://www.media.mit.edu/publications/your-brain-on-chatgpt/
